consolidation_rationale: All six absorbed ideas trace to one seam: /retro's mining core assumes exactly one substrate (Claude JSONL, read-side only). A registry with a Substrate interface plus claude/codex adapters closes the codex-session gap (T10-F4-3, S-35, T10-F6-3) and gives PR-review-thread mining (T10-F3-2) and chaperone write-side emission (H-F1-5) the same plug-in seam, instead of four bespoke scripts. The moonshot-tagged dual-engine reconciliation facet (T10-F6-4) is folded in as an optional, gated, advisory-only capability on the same registry rather than split into a separate issue, since it reuses the identical skeleton envelope the other five facets already produce.

executor_profile.justification: Touches four coupled surfaces (new registry abstraction, new adapter, new mining script, write-side emission in two existing chaperone dispatch paths) and must preserve byte-for-byte backward compatibility on the existing Claude-only path while introducing a genuinely new abstraction boundary a future engine must implement without touching /retro core — an architectural-seam judgment call, not a mechanical transform of an already-fixed target shape. team-execution gives reviewer consensus and validator gates across the four touched surfaces. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.
